_README: EPS LOW-SPEED-BAND bench config (closed course). Copy to config.json to use. MODE=lowspeed inverts the parked interlock: commands ONLY inside [V_MIN,V_MAX] km/h, armed by the clutch-released signal and a speed-gated START. Run 1 proved the EPS won't actuate parked (engage ~=10 km/h). Method: CLOSED_COURSE_TEST_DIRECTIVE_2026-10-25.md. START SMALL; raise TARGET/MAX_CMD deliberately across runs toward the +/-0x2b4e (34% ~= 11086) cap, never near the ~2048/50% motor ceiling without firmware-team sign-off. STEER_TORQUE full-scale +/-4096.
_MODE: parked | lowspeed. Selects which injector state machine runs.
_V_MIN: km/h. Engage-band floor (firmware min engage ~10; keep margin). START requires speed >= V_MIN + V_START_MARGIN.
_V_MAX: km/h. Hard band ceiling - abort (ramp to 0) above this.
_V_START_MARGIN: km/h above V_MIN required to START (EPS provably engaged).
_V_DROP: km/h below V_MIN that aborts a run (EPS would disengage anyway).
_T_MAX: s. Max duration of a commanded run, from the RUNNING start. Auto-stop.
_TARGET: raw |STEER_TORQUE| peak of the single-direction ramp. First runs well BELOW the cap (300 ~= 7%). Raise deliberately.
_MAX_CMD: HARD magnitude ceiling, independent of TARGET. Raise deliberately; never near the ~2048 motor ceiling without sign-off.
_MAX_RATE: raw units/s anti-slam rate limit (applies to ramp-up and ramp-out). Never a step.
_RAMP_S: intended 0 -> TARGET ramp time; the per-frame step is the stricter of MAX_RATE and TARGET/RAMP_S.
_DIRECTION: +1 or -1: single-direction ramp. Do single-direction runs first; add the opposite direction only after they are clean.
_SET_STEER_DOWN_TO_ZERO: stock non-TJA frame. ASK the firmware team before enabling.
_SPEED_STALE_S: 0x158 older than this = speed unknown -> no START / abort a run.
_CLUTCH_STALE_S: 0x130 older than this (or both clutch bits set) = clutch unknown.
_ARM_REQUIRES_CLUTCH: true = ARM only on the clutch-released rising edge (closed-course default). false = auto-arm (BENCH/DEBUG only).
_SESSION_TIMEOUT_S: global watchdog from injector start -> ramp to 0.
